title: Bridge Captain Gear VR (2016)
subtitle: Unity, Gear VR
text: Once I got the Gear VR for Christmas 2016, I never left my room for a week and self determined that VR was the future of gaming! I quickly learned that VR game design is considerably different then typical game design. Thus, I had to scrap Bridge Captain 3D and start over again. I was able to get the entire polygon count to ~10K polygons and it ran pretty smooth on my S6 Edge.

featured.description: Built many 2D/3D games and graphic engines with XAML like scripting using Direct X and Open GL. This includes an optimized procedurally generated Voxel engine.
